messages:
Nina Patel: FYI  Emberlane EBR locked for Fri 2026-04-17 08:30am PT. Need: one-slide health snapshot, renewal risk heatmap, short training recap, and a single ask for the execs. Can folks claim slides? Dry-run Thu 2026-04-16 09:00am PT.

Marcus Reed: I'll own the health snapshot. Will include activation %, DAU trend, and top 3 open CS tickets. Planning a small chart for APAC vs NA usage.

Janelle Ortiz: I'll take the renewal risk heatmap + mitigation owners. Will call out contract velocity and infra commit gaps. @Ravi Menon can you add Dedicated utilization numbers?

Ravi Menon: On it  will add GPU-hours vs commit and a note about the upcoming maintenance window. Also recommend we flag a performance regression in a single bullet if it still shows after this week's patch.

Samira Ali: I'll draft the training recap and the recommended follow-up plan (2 workshops + playbook handoff). Also will prepare a 2-question feedback form to embed in the deck.

Nina Patel: Great. Please add slide drafts to the shared deck by Wed EOD: https://docs.google.com/d/emberlane-ebr. Label slides with owner name + readiness (draft/ready). We'll aim for 8min exec summary, 20min walkthrough, 10min asks + next steps, Q&A.

Marcus Reed: Quick note  noticed a small retention dip starting Apr 2 in EU region. Hypothesis: they toggled a feature flag. Adding a short note and a pointer to the ticket.

Janelle Ortiz: Heatmap draft uploaded. Two amber risks: infra commit shortfall and onboarding velocity. Added proposed owners and target close dates.

Ravi Menon: Uploaded utilization numbers. Committed GPU-hours are ~9% underutilized last cycle. Added a small cost-vs-usage graph for the billing readout.

Samira Ali: Training slide uploaded  includes attendance and outstanding enablement asks. Proposing a targeted infra workshop before renewal.

Nina Patel: Can someone run a quick staging demo during the dry-run? We should include p95 latency and a sample trace id. @Marcus?

Marcus Reed: I can run the demo. Command I'll use: ```curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"emberlane smoke"}'``` Will post trace id after run.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy completed at 2026-04-10T14:05:00Z  smoke tests passed.

Marcus Reed: Demo done  p95 270ms, no new 5xx. Trace id ember-demo-20260410 included in notes.

Nina Patel: Thanks. After dry-run I'll consolidate action items and owners and send the rehearsal invite. Please be ready to present your slide for ~3 minutes. Also mark slides with 'ready' when complete.

Janelle Ortiz: Added mitigation owners and ETA to the deck.

Ravi Menon: Reviewed perf slide  marked as DRAFT pending one more run after the patch.

Samira Ali: Feedback form link added to the deck (3 short questions: top concern, usefulness of training, preferred follow-up).

Nina Patel: Closing loop  dry-run Thu 9am PT. If anything blocks you from delivering, call it out here. Otherwise I'll see you at the rehearsal.

Marcus Reed: All set from my side.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created by Nina Patel for Emberlane EBR dry-run 2026-04-16T16:00:00Z.
